text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nee-shi-shi-shi...! Even if you keep such 
a serious face, it's utterly useless!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're actually scared of Windy-chan, 
aren't ya! Windy-chan sees right through 
you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. That's wonderful. You're even 
conscious of unique hand movements and 
tone of voice."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
At first glance it feels wild, yet it 
holds an undeniable cuteness... I can 
certainly learn a lot from this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What nonsense are you talking about?! 
Educational, you say... Ah! Wait, don't 
tell me you want to become Windy-chan's 
apprentice?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go so far as to call it an 
apprenticeship... but if it is learning to 
produce the finest results, I would be 
delighted.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right! In that case, try copying 
Windy-chan! Put your hands like this, 
and... ROAR!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Wait up! If you're gonna show off your 
personality with an intimidating pose like 
that, you gotta go more like...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—And if I express beast-like ferocity like 
this... No, should I still retain some 
cuteness even here...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, uu... uwaah... Th-This guy... is 
terrifying, nodaaa...!!
